purpose: Pre-registration of the 2024 out-of-year evaluation. The plan is fixed before the 2024 source is even published, so that no model, rule or metric can be chosen with knowledge of the 2024 outcome.

status.confirmation_state: the 2024 year is the first evaluation year that was never inspected during the 2016-2022 exploration
status.source_availability_check: the FEC catalogue page https://www.fec.gov/introduction-campaign-finance/election-results-and-voting-information/ lists the biennial Federal Elections editions only up to 2022 on 2026-10-26, and https://www.fec.gov/introduction-campaign-finance/election-results-and-voting-information/federal-elections-2024/ returns HTTP 404
status.consequence: if the publication is still unavailable when the evaluation is attempted, the evaluation ends with a documented reason and no value is produced

data.cohort: the frozen 916 House voting contests of 2016/2018/2020/2022 are the training material and are not modified
data.evaluation_n: unknown; the count is declared unknown in advance and the actual count is reported with the exclusion breakdown
data.prediction_unit: one House contest, that is one state and one district; district numbers are not comparable across the 2022 and 2024 boundaries, and no cross-year district continuity is assumed
data.feature_definition: the Republican two-party share of the Primary of the same contest
data.target_definition: the Republican two-party share of the General election of the same contest; a two-party vote lead, NOT a certified winner
data.label_definition: the classification label is the two-party vote lead, not the certified election winner

models.name: primary-carryover
models.role: pre-registered reference for the Primary-to-General relation

models.name: linear
models.role: the primary evaluation candidate, the frozen baseline form

models.name: polynomial2-ridge
models.role: pre-registered challenger, kept although the 2016-2022 comparison found no stable improvement

models.name: cubic-spline-ridge
models.role: pre-registered challenger, kept although the 2016-2022 comparison found no stable improvement

excluded_from_the_model_set.constant_mean: reported as a floor reference only, never as a candidate
excluded_from_the_model_set.candidate_level_features: the Primary candidate counts, the concentration index and the vote volume are excluded from the 2024 model set, because the ablation of 2016-2022 found no stable improvement and the features add a parsing burden; the exclusion is decided before the 2024 result is known
excluded_from_the_model_set.classification_models: the classifier is evaluated with the frozen linear share as its single feature, and no new classifier is fitted

training.rule: re-fit the same model form on all 916 frozen cohort rows of 2016/2018/2020/2022; the 2024 rows are never used for fitting
training.refit_rationale: the model form and the hyperparameters are fixed, and the whole pre-2024 cohort is available; re-fitting is the same measurement as the frozen backtests, which refit on every year before the test year
training.hyperparameter_search: none; the hyperparameters are fixed constants and no search, grid or inner validation is performed
training.standardization: the polynomial and the spline designs are centred and scaled with the training mean and standard deviation only

metrics.metric_unit: percentage points, that is the share multiplied by 100
metrics.paired_comparison: the per-contest absolute error difference against the linear reference model and against the Primary carry-over, bootstrapped over states

bootstrap.status: exploratory; the districts are not a random sample
bootstrap.reason_for_state_unit: the districts of one state share the electoral rules and the candidate pool, so they are not independent

exclusion_rules.rule_set: the rules of the frozen 2016-2022 cohort are applied unchanged
categories: special election with no Primary counterpart
exclusion_rules.blind_execution: the category list is fixed before the 2024 data are read; only the assignment of a contest to an already declared category may be recorded afterwards, and no category may be added, renamed or removed afterwards
exclusion_rules.no_zero_filling: a missing numeric value is never replaced by zero
exclusion_rules.no_subtotal_merging: a party subtotal is never merged into the candidate votes
exclusion_rules.unknown_in_advance: the number of 2024 contests that fall into each category is unknown in advance and is reported as unknown in the plan

reporting_rules: the evaluation is executed from the frozen configuration only; the primary comparison is confirmatory for 2024 because the year was never inspected
every metric is reported for every model and for the whole 2024 cohort, including results that are worse than the reference model
the number of evaluated contests, the number of excluded contests and the reason of every exclusion are reported
the 2022 results and the 2024 results are shown in separate tables
a change to any rule of this configuration is a new protocol version and turns the 2024 result into an exploratory one
no value is produced when the source or a rule is unavailable; the reason is recorded instead
forbidden_operations: looking at any 2024 House vote total, winner or error before this configuration is committed
changing the model set, the hyperparameters, the preprocessing or the metric after the 2024 result is seen
searching hyperparameters on the 2024 rows or on any year after 2016
adding, removing or re-weighting a state or a district after the 2024 label is seen
re-deriving the write-in, fusion, unopposed or missing-value rules from the 2024 source
reporting the 2024 result as the performance of the whole United States; the evaluated set is a selected set of contests
reading a political causal effect out of a vote share

planned_source.expected_publication: the biennial FEC Federal Elections compilation, the PDF and the Excel workbook of the 2024 edition
planned_source.document_id: unknown; the identifier is assigned by the FEC when the edition is published
planned_source.sha256: unknown; the checksum is recorded at retrieval time, before any sheet is parsed
retrieval_order: 1. confirm the catalogue page exists and record its URL and the retrieval date
2. download the workbook and record the URL, the byte size and the SHA-256
3. record the sheet names and the column header row only
4. only then parse the vote tables
planned_source.separation_from_the_frozen_catalog: the 2024 record goes into a separate 2024 catalogue file; data/sources/fec_publications.json keeps the 2010-2022 entries unchanged
